patch_metadata.description: Adds VG_CLERK_FACTUAL_DATA_INTEGRITY validation gate to detect extraction errors in contact info, dates, company names, and education data. Prevents silent data corruption bugs like phone number truncation. Adds QA Report Section 0 for factual data validation.
patch_metadata.root_cause: Zero validation of Clerk-extracted factual data; workflow assumed deterministic extraction = infallible extraction

new_validation_gate.philosophy: Validate extracted factual data before Artist phase consumes it. Deterministic extraction does not guarantee correctness.

fields.on_fail: HALT_WITH_MESSAGE: 'Name field missing or invalid length'
HALT_WITH_MESSAGE: 'Phone number format invalid. Expected: +1-XXX-XXX-XXXX (16 characters)'

per_entry_checks.on_fail: HALT_WITH_MESSAGE: 'Company name missing or invalid for entry {index}'
HALT_WITH_MESSAGE: 'Job title missing or invalid for entry {index}'
HALT_WITH_MESSAGE: 'Start date format invalid for {company}. Expected: MMMM YYYY'
HALT_WITH_MESSAGE: 'End date format invalid for {company}. Expected: MMMM YYYY or Present'
WARNING: 'Overview missing or too short for {company}'

chronology_validation.check: Validate dates are in reverse chronological order
chronology_validation.on_chronology_violation: HALT_WITH_MESSAGE: 'Experience entries not in reverse chronological order'

per_entry_checks.on_fail: HALT_WITH_MESSAGE: 'Degree field missing or invalid for entry {index}'
HALT_WITH_MESSAGE: 'Institution field missing or invalid for entry {index}'
WARNING: 'Certification text too short at index {index}'

output_on_success.log_message: ✅ VG_CLERK_FACTUAL_DATA_INTEGRITY: All factual data validated successfully

phase_1_enhancement.on_failure: If VG_CLERK_FACTUAL_DATA_INTEGRITY fails, HALT_WORKFLOW_AND_GENERATE_CLERK_ERROR_REPORT (not standard failure report)

remediation_guidance.for_users: If Clerk validation fails, check master resume file for data format errors. Common issues: phone number typos, missing email domain, dates not in 'MMMM YYYY' format.
remediation_guidance.for_developers: VG_CLERK_FACTUAL_DATA_INTEGRITY failures indicate extraction bugs in Clerk phase. Check regex patterns, JSON parsing logic, and string manipulation functions.
